art_direction: Bold smooth hand-drawn interlocking doodles; warm white, charcoal and orange.

assets.subject: mathematics
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Redesign the referenced mathematics illustration to follow the user's correction: MUCH BOLDER, SMOOTHER, SOFTER ROUND STROKES, substantially MORE ELEMENTS, and elements that INTERACT rather than isolated icons.
Produce one standalone wide 2.6:1 MATHEMATICS illustration for the upper image slot of a study subject card, no interface.
Style: charming sophisticated hand-drawn white marker doodles, soft rounded stroke caps and joins, gentle organic wobble, bold even lines approximately 9 to 13 px on a 1600px canvas, clean silky smooth ink, no scratchy pencil or distressed chalk grain. This is a grown-up creative sketchbook composition, not kids clipart, not rigid CAD vectors.
Composition: a dense but readable horizontal interlocking constellation of 12-15 mathematics objects and symbols. A large central wireframe cube sharing an edge with a triangle; a chunky pencil leaning across the cube drawing a sweeping smooth curve; a coordinate graph below with that curve passing through; a tilted ruler tucked behind the pencil; a small cone; a compass drawing a circle to the right, the circle meeting an infinity loop; integral, pi, sigma, x squared and plus/minus marks tucked into gaps; two or three small outlined diamonds and rounded motion strokes. Every object feels part of one connected lively visual scene, with overlap, contact, shared lines and flowing curves weaving between forms. Varied sizes, playful rotations, no straight row of separated symbols, no individually framed icons. Keep good breathing room around the silhouette and between important shapes. No cropped objects.
Palette: warm off-white #e8e5df marker lines and very limited bright orange #ff6a00 highlights on the sweeping curve and the pencil tip, under 10% orange, on a solid uniform charcoal-black #202020 background. No gradients, shadows, lighting, paper or background textures. No text labels or subject title; only simple mathematical symbols.
The entire composition must be readable at 440×170px: larger thick lines and confident simplified shapes, not tiny technical details.

assets.subject: physics
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new subject illustration as part of EXACTLY the same visual series as the attached mathematics reference. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE; replace ALL of its mathematics objects with the subject-specific objects below. Keep its identical bold warm-white marker line weight, soft rounded stroke ends and joins, smooth gently imperfect hand-drawn geometry, dynamic interlocking collage, varied sizes, generous silhouette padding, flat charcoal #202020 backdrop and tiny vivid orange #ff6a00 accents. The image will be an illustration in a JustStudy subject card. Draw thick enough to read beautifully at 440×170 pixels. Wide horizontal format approx 2.6:1. 12-15 related objects and little marks, integrated into one composition through overlap, physical contact and flowing connecting lines rather than a row of separate icons. Color distribution: 90-95% warm off-white marks, at most 5-10% orange marks. No grey shading, no gradients, no 3D rendering, no glow, no paper or background texture. No people, no faces. No interface, no card container, no titles, no words, no labels. Tiny abstract marks, motion strokes and outlined diamonds only in a few gaps.
SUBJECT: PHYSICS. A large central atom diagram with a small orange nucleus, one orbital path continuing into a flowing sine wave; a horseshoe magnet on the left interacting with the curve through 3 bold field lines; a Newton-style swinging pendulum suspended from a short tilted bar above the wave, the bob in orange; a chunky prism near the right splitting one simple ray into two white rays and one orange ray; a tiny ringed planet with orbital arc; a spring coil attached to a small weight; a lightning bolt meeting the magnet field, an arrow showing motion, a small outlined star and two abstract sparks. Arrange and partially overlap the atom, pendulum, wave, spring, magnet, prism and planet as one connected lively physics sketch. All outlined in the same bold friendly marker. Objects remain recognizable.
